versions.changelog:
Initial release of Matchmaker: AI-powered dating and relationship guidance.

- Offers profile analysis, personalized compatibility assessments, icebreaker suggestions, and relationship tracking.
- Supports detailed info gathering: personality, lifestyle, values, and interests.
- Template-driven, actionable advice for individuals and couples at any relationship stage.
- Provides ready-to-use output formats for clear, engaging results.
- Designed to empower meaningful connections with AI-driven recommendations.
